markdownDescription:
## Steal the Format

Paste a post that worked and a few lines about your brand, and get five post ideas built on the same format, plus a ready-to-film script for the idea you pick. The ideas borrow the post's structure (its format, hook mechanic, beat order and pacing), never its words, footage, music, faces or logos.

1. **Post link**: a TikTok, Reels, Shorts or YouTube link. The template starts with an example Reel; paste your own to replace it.
2. **Your brand**: what you sell, who it is for, your tone, the goal, the call to action, and what you never do.
3. **Video Analysis**: reads the post, its timings, words, on-screen text and sound.
4. **Content Recipe**: explains why the post works, from the hook and the format to the beats, the call to action and the pace.
5. **Content Ideas**: five ideas for your brand on the same structure.
6. **Script**: a ready-to-film script for one idea, idea 1 by default. Click the wire into Script and change the number to pick another, or set it to Each for a script per idea.

data.title: Steal the format: how it works
data.text:
Paste the link of a post that worked and a few lines about your brand. You get five post ideas built on the same format, and a ready-to-film script for the one you pick.

1. Post link: a TikTok, Reels, Shorts or YouTube link. The template starts with an example Reel; paste your own to replace it.
2. Your brand: what you sell, who it is for, your tone, the goal, the call to action, and what you never do.
3. Video Analysis: reads the post, its timings, words, on-screen text and sound.
4. Content Recipe: explains why the post works, from the hook and the format to the beats, the call to action and the pace.
5. Content Ideas: five ideas for your brand that reuse the structure. Never the words, footage, music, faces or logos.
6. Script: a ready-to-film script for the idea you pick. The workflow ends here.

data.label: Step 1
data.title: 1 · Post link
data.text: Paste the link of one post that performed: TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts or YouTube. The template starts with an example Reel; paste your own link to replace it. The video downloads when the link lands, or when you run. A post up to a minute costs the least to analyze; a longer YouTube video asks you to pick a part first (up to 10 minutes).

data.label: Step 2
data.title: 2 · Your brand
data.text: A few plain lines: what you sell, who it is for, your tone, the goal of the video, the call to action, and what the brand never does. The ideas are only as specific as this text, and they are written in its language.

data.label: Step 3
data.title: 3 · Video Analysis
data.text: Watches the post and writes down what happens and when: the scenes, every spoken word, the on-screen text and the sound. Priced by the post's length.

data.label: Step 4
data.title: 4 · Content Recipe
data.text: Turns the analysis into a recipe: the hook in the first three seconds and why it stops the scroll, the format, the beats, why it works, the call to action, the sound and the pace. The post's link rides along, so every idea points back to it.

data.label: Step 5
data.title: 5 · Content Ideas
data.text: Five ideas for your brand on the same structure: format, hook mechanic, beat order and pacing. Never the original's words, footage, music, faces or brand marks. Set 1 to 10 ideas in its settings; six or more cost a second batch.

data.label: Step 6
data.title: 6 · Scripts
data.text: Writes a ready-to-film script for ONE idea: idea 1 by default. To pick another, click the wire from Content Ideas into Script and change the number (3 = the third idea). Set it to Each to get a script for every idea. The workflow stops at the script.

data.label: Your brand
data.text: Brand: A creator teaching people how to turn their personal experience, skills, and knowledge into a high-ticket digital offer. Product: a step-by-step AI method that interviews you, identifies what you can sell, finds the right audience, structures the offer, validates a $3K–$10K price point, and builds the positioning and messaging. Audience: people with real experience or expertise who want to create and sell a digital course, program, consulting offer, service, or community but do not know what to package or how to position it. Tone: direct, confident, intriguing, simple, slightly provocative, never corporate. Goal: create a 30-second viral-style video inspired by the reference video’s structure, showing how ordinary knowledge can be turned into a valuable digital offer, then revealing that AI can help build the offer. CTA: ask viewers to comment a specific keyword to receive the full prompt by DM. Never: copy the original creator’s exact wording, footage, identity, branding, or make fabricated income claims.

data.label: Script
data.systemPrompt:
You write scripts for short vertical social videos (9:16, about 30 seconds). You receive one post idea: its hook, format, beats, shot list and call to action. Turn it into one ready-to-film script.
- Open on the idea's hook line in the first second, and keep the idea's beat order.
- Write numbered scenes. For each: the time range, what we see, the spoken line or voice-over, and any on-screen text.
- End on the idea's call to action.
- Plain text, in the language of the idea. No preamble, no notes, no alternatives.
